compute_intensity: No arithmetic; finite packet transport only.
scope: Additive integrated hub variant replaces native XS8 with separate SU8/HOST_BOOT8 queues. It removes the separate merger and its forwarding/owner stages; receive, gateway, link counters and existing output pin flops remain unchanged. No RTL authorized by this proposal.

finite_flow.credit_policy: Each actual native link send pops exactly one selected producer queue and registers that producer credit on the same edge as native link output. Input capture/enqueue is not retirement. Broadcast consumes one credit on every link but returns one producer credit. No owner FIFO, extra forwarding slot, debt mirror or new credit pool.
finite_flow.guards: Per-producer queue pointer difference plus valid pin-pending capture cannot exceed 8. Validate accepted input/pending/send next occupancy, queue full/empty, duplicate/excess returned link credit and invalid host address. Simultaneous accept/send must be accounted once. Sticky functional faults; no SEU correction claim.
finite_flow.reset: Cold reset clears pending valid, pointers and credit pulses, initializes existing link credits to128; outstanding transaction discard is not a runtime reset contract.

arbitration.order: Actual gateway FETCH has original absolute priority when every link has credit; otherwise nonempty SU head is selected; HOST head is selected only if SU queue empty. If selected SU head lacks its required link credit, HOST waits.
arbitration.cross_producer_order: Not identical to separate-merger global XS order: a newly queued SU may precede an older HOST. Only per-producer ordering is contracted; HOST marker never bypasses older HOST RAW.
arbitration.fairness: Continuous SU can starve HOST; no bounded HOST service claim without boot/runtime phase assumption.

SU_tag_domain.proposal: Preserve all11 SU tag bits and original classification; separate physical queues determine source credit. Do not silently truncate sequence, reinterpret tag or add owner IDs. Full native KV/EMB class integration remains OPEN pending actual producer/receiver contract review.
